#!/bin/sh
# Nightly log backup. Bundles logs/ into a tarball and copies it to the destination.
set -eu

DEST="backup-srv:/srv/nightly"
STAMP=$(date +%Y%m%d)
BUNDLE="logs-$STAMP.tar.gz"

if [ ! -d logs ]; then
    echo "backup.sh: logs/ directory not found, nothing to back up" >&2
    exit 1
fi

tar -czf "$BUNDLE" logs/

if ! scp -p "$BUNDLE" "$DEST/"; then
    echo "backup.sh: failed to copy $BUNDLE to $DEST" >&2
    exit 1
fi

echo "wrote $BUNDLE and copied it to $DEST"
